slides.Slide_2: BACKEND API REST API Endpoints Flask routes powering the frontend and scheduler METHOD ENDPOINT DESCRIPTION GET /api/prices/live Fetch live gold / silver / platinum / USD-INR prices GET /api/prices/history/<metal> OHLC historical data for candlestick charts POST /api/auth/login User login with bcrypt password verification POST /api/auth/register New user registration with hashed password GET /api/investments/<sector> Blue-chip companies by sector (market cap, returns) POST /api/advisor/recommend Rule-based investment recommendation result GET /api/alerts Retrieve authenticated user's active price alerts POST /api/alerts Create a new price alert (metal, condition, target) GET /api/news Latest market news filtered by metal relevance

slides.Slide_4: TECHNICAL STACK Technology Stack & Deployment Libraries, tools, and running the production server LAYER TECHNOLOGY PURPOSE Language Python 3.11 Core backend language Web Framework Flask 3.x + Flask-CORS REST API routes and session handling WSGI Server Waitress Production multi-threaded server Database MySQL 8 / mysql-connector Persistent storage, InnoDB engine Auth bcrypt Password hashing and verification Scheduler APScheduler Background price fetch & alert checks HTTP Client requests Calling external pricing APIs Frontend HTML5 / CSS3 / Vanilla JS No framework — pure browser APIs QUICK START # Install dependencies pip install flask flask-cors pip install waitress bcrypt pip install apscheduler pip install mysql-connector-python # Setup database mysql -u root -p < setup_database.sql # Start server python run_waitress.py # Or use batch file run_server.bat

slides.Slide_6: ANALYSIS Limitations  &  Future Enhancements Current Limitations ▸ Local Flask server — no cloud deployment ▸ Requires active internet connection ▸ No HTTPS, 2FA or encrypted sessions ▸ Rule-based advisor — no ML predictions ▸ Dashboard alerts only — no email/SMS ▸ Single user role — no admin panel ▸ No portfolio or transaction history ▸ No automated database backup Future Enhancements ▸ Cloud deployment on AWS / Render / Railway ▸ ML-based smart investment recommendations ▸ Email & SMS real-time price alerts ▸ Portfolio management with P&L tracking ▸ Android / iOS mobile application ▸ HTTPS, 2FA & enhanced security ▸ Advanced candlestick & predictive charts ▸ AI chatbot for investment guidance
slides.Slide_7: PROJECT OVERVIEW What is MetalCur? A full-stack web application for precious metal tracking & intelligent investment advisory Platform Overview Real-time gold, silver, platinum & USD/INR tracking Live price charts with 3-year historical data (seeded) Rule-based Investment Advisor — Stock & SIP mode 90 Blue-chip companies listed under NSE & BSE Live share price, 5Y returns & real-time capital value Risk-based recommendations (Low / Medium / High) Price alerts, market news, and user accounts with themes Frontend HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript Backend Python Flask + Flask-CORS Database MySQL 8 · metalcur schema Server Waitress WSGI (production) Pricing Live API + last_live_cache.json
slides.Slide_8: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE How the System Works End-to-end flow from browser to database USER BROWSER ▸  HTML/CSS/JS Frontend ▸  Fetch API · Dark/Light Theme ⇄ FLASK BACKEND ▸  REST API Routes ▸  APScheduler · bcrypt auth ⇄ MYSQL DATABASE ▸  metalcur schema ▸  6 tables · InnoDB engine ⇄ EXTERNAL APIs ▸  Live metal prices ▸  USD/INR exchange rates ⏱  APScheduler runs background jobs every 2 minutes — fetches live prices from external APIs, updates the metal_price table, then checks and fires pending user price alerts automatically.
